mechanism: Combined diuretic and SGLT2 inhibitor effects increase dehydration, electrolyte loss, and acute kidney injury risk; empagliflozin also increases euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis risk when combined with loop diuretics.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and volume status closely; ensure adequate hydration; assess for signs of DKA; consider dose adjustment or alternative therapy if eGFR declines.
